description: This file defines the EvernoteConverter class responsible for parsing Evernote ENEX files into internal data structures, converting XML content, and handling tags and notes. It includes methods for reading files, parsing XML, and processing note content.

classes.name: EvernoteConverter
classes.description: A class for converting Evernote ENEX files into internal data structures, handling XML parsing, and managing notes and tags.

methods.name: convertENEXFileToNotesAndTags
methods.description: Reads an ENEX file and converts its content into notes and tags.

methods.name: parseENEXData
methods.description: Parses the ENEX XML data string into note and tag objects, optionally stripping HTML.

methods.name: loadXMLString
methods.description: Parses a string into an XML or HTML document.

methods.name: stripHTML
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string to produce plain text.
